assumptions: Frequentist sampling from a fixed true distribution with increasing information
conclusion: The paper studies how rapidly Gaussian-process-based posterior distributions contract around a fixed truth in global parameter metrics.
span: In the frequentist set-up, in which the data are sampled from a fixed “true” distribution and the amount of information in the data increases indefinitely, the corresponding posterior distributions often contract to the fixed true distribution, which is referred to as posterior consistency. In this paper, we study the rate of contraction of the posterior distribution relative to global metrics on the parameters.
